title: Government whistleblowers claim UFO retrievals

tellings.quote: their government whistleblowers coming out of saying that they've retrieved UFOs one of whom I've had on my show and like you know it's kind of hard to park poke holes in his story

plain: Government insiders have come forward to say the United States has recovered UFOs, according to Michels. He says one of these whistleblowers has been a guest on his own show, and that it is "kind of hard to poke holes in his story." He brings it up himself, without naming the man, as a reason to take the question seriously.
